repos.name: supabase/supabase
repos.description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
repos.one_liner: An open-source Firebase alternative that provides a full backend-as-a-service built on top of PostgreSQL.
bullets: Tech Stack: PostgreSQL, Go, GoTrue, PostgREST, and Realtime engine.
Purpose: Simplifies backend development by providing instant APIs, authentication, and database management.
Use Cases: Rapid prototyping for fintech apps, managing user data for AI agents, and building scalable web/mobile backends.

repos.name: Tencent/BrowserSkill
repos.description: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
repos.one_liner: A browser automation framework that enables AI agents to interact with real, logged-in web sessions.
bullets: Tech Stack: Rust-based CLI and browser extension architecture.
Purpose: Bridges the gap between LLM reasoning and complex web interfaces by allowing agents to perform authenticated actions.
Use Cases: Automating financial data extraction from banking portals, managing SaaS workflows, and agentic web navigation.

repos.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.one_liner: A collection of production-grade engineering skills and patterns designed to enhance AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: JavaScript/TypeScript-based modular skill definitions.
Purpose: Provides standardized, reliable tool-use capabilities for LLMs to perform complex software engineering tasks.
Use Cases: Improving the reliability of autonomous coding agents, automating code refactoring, and building robust devtools.

repos.name: jmiao24/Paper2Agent
repos.description: Paper2Agent is a multi-agent AI system that automatically transforms research papers into interactive AI agents.
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent system that automatically converts academic research papers into functional, interactive AI agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python, Jupyter Notebooks, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
Purpose: Accelerates the transition from theoretical research to practical, agentic implementation.
Use Cases: Rapidly deploying specialized financial analysis agents based on new quant research or academic papers.

repos.name: nats-io/nats-server
repos.description: High-Performance server for NATS.io, the cloud and edge native messaging system.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, cloud-native messaging system designed for secure communication across distributed infrastructure.
bullets: Tech Stack: Written in Go, utilizing a lightweight, high-throughput pub/sub messaging protocol.
Purpose: Provides the backbone for low-latency communication between microservices and edge devices.
Use Cases: Building high-frequency trading backends, real-time data streaming for fintech, and orchestrating distributed AI agent networks.
